trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"crash report","code":"MSAN report names QImage::pixel -> XCFImageFormat::mergeIndexedAToRGB -> XCFImageFormat::mergeLayerIntoImage","note":"The vulnerable path is in XCF decoding, specifically indexed-alpha layer merging."},
{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimgio_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"data/size","code":"b.setData((const char *)data, size); handler->setDevice(&b); handler->read(&i);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are fed directly into the XCF image handler."},
{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimageformats/src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::readXCF","line":318,"var":"xcf_image","code":"readXCF(QIODevice *device, QImage *outImage)","note":"The parser interprets the input as an XCF file and begins building an in-memory image/layer model."},
{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimageformats/src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::composeTiles","line":741,"var":"layer.image_tiles / layer.alpha_tiles","code":"composeTiles(XCFImage &xcf_image)","note":"For indexed-alpha images, the code allocates separate indexed image tiles and alpha tiles, then later merges them."},
{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimageformats/src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadLevel","line":1067,"var":"layer.tile","code":"loadTileRLE(...); layer.assignBytes(layer, i, j);","note":"Tile bytes are decompressed from attacker-controlled RLE data and copied into the per-tile images."},
{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimageformats/src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::copyLayerToImage","line":1541,"var":"copy","code":"if (copy == copyRGBToRGB && layer.apply_mask != 1) ... else (*copy)(layer, i, j, k, l, image, m, n);","note":"After the base layer is initialized, higher layers are composited pixel-by-pixel into the final image."},
{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimageformats/src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::copyIndexedAToRGB","line":1796,"var":"src_a","code":"uchar src_a = layer.alpha_tiles[j][i].pixelIndex(k, l); src_a = INT_MULT(src_a, layer.opacity);","note":"For indexed-alpha layers, the merge path reads the alpha tile and uses it to decide whether the source pixel should be opaque or transparent."},
{"step":8,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimageformats/src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::mergeLayerIntoImage","line":1823,"var":"merge","code":"if (layer.type == INDEXEDA_GIMAGE) { if (xcf_image.image.depth() <= 8) merge = mergeIndexedAToIndexed; else merge = mergeIndexedAToRGB; }","note":"The vulnerable candidate reaches the indexed-alpha RGB merge path when the destination image is true-color."},
{"step":9,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kimageformats/src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::mergeIndexedAToRGB","line":2639,"var":"src","code":"QRgb src = layer.image_tiles[j][i].pixel(k, l); uchar src_a = layer.alpha_tiles[j][i].pixelIndex(k, l); image.setPixel(m, n, qRgba(src, src_a));","note":"The sink dereferences tile pixels during compositing; the reported crash is a use-of-uninitialized-value observed at QImage::pixel in this merge routine."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(path)
